name: @authenticator/server
description: Go API. These scripts just wrap go commands so turbo can run them.

scripts.lint: go vet ./... && (command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null && golangci-lint run || echo 'golangci-lint not installed, ran go vet only')
scripts.db:create-test: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres psql -U authenticator -c 'CREATE DATABASE authenticator_test' || true
